notes_for_editor: Thin record. The bearing sources are the FFLA list (standing, coordinates), TopoQuest (county, elevation), a Central US page that holds only a title and county, and a statewide WJFW article. No build date, builder, design, staffing, fire history, ownership or access was found, so no facts block is written. The WJFW article says 72 towers were decommissioned in 2015; whether Blue Hills was one of them is unknown. A Rusk County museum post mentions CCC work near the Blue Hills area but does not describe this tower, so it is not used. Used 2 web searches and about 4 page reads.
